title: Asking Jessie, now manager, and meeting Pete Johnson
summary: Refused by the band, he went to Jessie's new club where she deferred to the owners; Pete Johnson and others were the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: So, I went up there. I asked the man to let me sing. He wouldn't. So I thought, "I know where I'll go. I'll go up to another nightclub I know...where Jessie worked there."
So when I went down there to see Jessie, she didn't work there no more. She done got moved up. She was the manager of the place. So I told her, I said, "Let me sing."
She say, "Well, now, if it was left up to me...but it's left up to the ownership."

So I said, "Okay, I'll go over and ast [sic] him." So I met my piano player that I used to work with so long--Pete Johnson. He was playin' there. Him and a cat called Merle...was a drummer, another cat called Piano Red...had another cat called Jones--Deacon Jones. But he used to try to preach. So he used to try to preach, and he was...he'd play in the band at night.
